author: mark
text: Stack changed from Dioxus-desktop to egui/eframe. Reason: Dioxus-desktop requires libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev (and friends) on Linux — a heavy, version-specific system dep incompatible with the repo's 'no weird system libs' aesthetic. egui is winit-based; its system deps (X11/Wayland core) are universal on any Linux desktop. The pluggability contract (§3.5) is unchanged; a future browser-based 'lernie-ui-web' crate would share the pure-Rust view-model layer.
